structural_change: S81-VE r3 10-19 (SAFE-DESIGN rebuild after route b571a8c2c NEEDS_RTL; r2 gate: one merged reset sync 2,320 loads, 1,230 roots >32): one ot_rst_relay with 18 kept region copies (<=32 reset loads each, valid/control only; FP units ve-local valid-only-reset copies; reset valid lines replaced by unit valid_out chaining); ring row selects one-hot per 8-bit slice (kept); kept operand copies per multiplier decode and per add lane gate; pack hold enable 24 kept copies; tree/pack data free of wide enables.
